adds.rationale: NuScale Power just became the first pure-play small modular reactor (SMR) company on a US exchange, giving direct entry into the nuclear buildup wave named as the profile's #4 next-wave priority.

news_evidence.summary: NuScale Power completed its business combination with Spring Valley Acquisition Corp., commencing trading on NYSE under ticker SMR (~$1.9B enterprise value, ~$380M gross proceeds including $235M PIPE from Samsung C&T, DS Private Equity, Segra Capital, and others)
NuScale held a company update call for investors and analysts, with CEO John Hopkins and CFO Chris Colbert reaffirming financial projections and reviewing recent business highlights

adds.rationale: Pandemic-era labor shortages are visibly pulling fresh capital into robotics and automation this quarter, supporting an early-buildup entry into the profile's #2 next-wave via a diversified, already-liquid robotics ETF rather than a single speculative name.

news_evidence.summary: "We've literally run out of human beings": labor shortage driving accelerated robotics/automation adoption in e-commerce and logistics, citing Agility Robotics' $150M raise from Amazon and others
Berkshire Grey reported Q1 2022 revenue of $5.5M (backlog $103M) and flagged Q2 2022 revenue running at $23.4M, a 421% YoY jump, evidencing accelerating order flow into warehouse robotics

rationale_overall: The watchlist grows from 7 to 9 tickers this quarter, filling in two of the profile's named next-waves (nuclear via SMR, robotics via BOTZ) with concrete Q2-2022 buildup evidence rather than speculation, while leaving room under the cap of 12. All existing holdings are kept: AAPL (WWDC22 M2-chip refresh), MSFT and GOOGL (steady cloud/search execution per their most recent pre-as-of-date prints), NVDA (record Q1 FY23 data-center and gaming revenue reported May 25, 2022), RKLB (SolAero integration progressing, new MDA/Globalstar contract, on-schedule Q2 launches), and ITA (Ukraine-driven Western defense-budget increases lifting the group). Quantum computing was searched but not added this round: the only investable pure-play, IonQ, drew securities-fraud suits in June 2022, and no fresh structural catalyst justified a diversified quantum ETF add yet, so that next-wave slot is deferred to a future quarter. Tanker/shipping (BWET) and eldercare REIT candidates were considered for the non-technology waves but rejected — BWET does not yet exist as a listed security as of this date, and no eldercare-specific catalyst surfaced this quarter.
